406b1051f399.text: A coat, a spare pair of heels, a makeup bag. And an envelope: "PEARL DANVERS, HEADSHOTS, 8 x 10".

b31429b0b6c6.speaker: ray
b31429b0b6c6.text: Twenty of them, signed, ready to hand out.

ea720cb2e684.speaker: ray
ea720cb2e684.text: She came back at two in the morning for her headshots. Here they are.

0137e5f565f3.speaker: ray
0137e5f565f3.text: Under the envelope, a legal pad. Somebody's written "Lyle Brandt" forty times in gold pen.

17ee77c51d4d.speaker: ray
17ee77c51d4d.text: The first ones are bad. The last ten are perfect. And a gold paint pen, cap chewed.

2c40c5871fd2.speaker: ray
2c40c5871fd2.text: Her headshots, a legal pad of somebody else's name, and a chewed gold pen.

05ce75555ff7.speaker: ray
05ce75555ff7.text: GUS. A cardigan, an umbrella, and a photo of a younger Gus shaking hands with Lyle Brandt.

c2620b90d273.speaker: ray
c2620b90d273.text: Fourteen steep steps up to the roof. One slipper on the third.

5dc61d10b97e.speaker: ray
5dc61d10b97e.text: Bills, invoices, a racing form from 1997. And on top, where he'd want to see it every morning...

239c3abfdaf8.speaker: ray
239c3abfdaf8.text: Last Thursday. A week old. If Pryce wanted Gus gone, all they had to do was wait twenty-three days.

f29a23763bc6.speaker: ray
f29a23763bc6.text: Calloway's Auctions, Beverly Hills. "Hollywood Legends, Fall Season." Came in today's mail, still in its plastic.

df060a3b1aca.speaker: ray
df060a3b1aca.text: A page turned down at the corner. Red ink, shaky capitals.

1b8dc419daa5.speaker: ray
1b8dc419daa5.text: Under the letter, a business card. Cream stock, raised blue type.

793cdb901091.speaker: ray
793cdb901091.text: A cop's card, from a cop who isn't one anymore.

9d4c2a31c598.speaker: ray
9d4c2a31c598.text: Lot of Walts in this town.

cf4a98bbe4ef.speaker: ray
cf4a98bbe4ef.text: He's polite about ugly. That's how you know he does it for a living.

6ef043054799.speaker: ray
6ef043054799.text: Twelve-forty, Calloway's. Nobody answers an auction house at midnight, so he left a message.

d2a404cff19d.speaker: ray
d2a404cff19d.text: She told me she went home at nine and came back at two-fifteen for her pictures. She left out the part where Gus called.

fe4dc6e32201.speaker: ray
fe4dc6e32201.text: Calloway's at twelve-forty. Pearl at twelve fifty-two.

b8724e575f88.speaker: ray
b8724e575f88.text: Morty, at four in the afternoon. A minute of arguing about something, I'd bet.

d05f52178c1e.speaker: ray
d05f52178c1e.text: Pryce, eight seconds. Gus hung up on them.

09316f8f3dd5.speaker: ray
09316f8f3dd5.text: A cigar box, a loupe, and a handheld UV lamp. Masking tape on it, in Gus's hand:

2329c67be469.speaker: ray
2329c67be469.text: "Modern ink glows. Old ink doesn't. Trust nobody."

a528493bd5da.speaker: ray
a528493bd5da.text: Trust nobody. He wrote it on a lamp, then trusted somebody.

fffbd1fb108e.speaker: ray
fffbd1fb108e.text: Nothing to compare it to yet.

a7edf6497709.speaker: ray
a7edf6497709.text: Let me see what's in there first.

77482c2c749e.speaker: ray
77482c2c749e.text: Her autograph on the headshots glows the same gold as Bogart's on the wall.

55f960ec1ac1.speaker: shah
55f960ec1ac1.text: Look at that. You can be taught.

248cfd0e71a1.speaker: shah
248cfd0e71a1.text: And look how long it took.

beac15e18716.speaker: shah
beac15e18716.text: Five points. That fits his palm. Bag it.

73066332aaec.speaker: shah
73066332aaec.text: Backward down fourteen wooden stairs. Skull fracture at the bottom, neck too. He'd have been gone before he stopped moving.

d74e1c53471a.speaker: shah
d74e1c53471a.text: Here. His keys were in his cardigan. I'm done with them.

e5793c6f7e89.speaker: shah
e5793c6f7e89.text: Between one-fifteen and one-forty-five. The roof door's been letting the rain in on him, so don't hold me to the minute.

459288e50b09.speaker: shah
459288e50b09.text: Old men fall. But old men fall forward, Ray, they grab for the rail. He went over backward.

547e6ccaa048.speaker: shah
547e6ccaa048.text: Two fresh bruises on the breastbone, side by side. The heels of two hands. Small hands.

7c78040c1ba0.speaker: shah
7c78040c1ba0.text: Somebody put both hands on his chest and shoved. Facing him.

74fac45810a8.speaker: shah
74fac45810a8.text: His right hand. Something scratched his palm, small and sharp, with points. And he smells of cigar.

b83482b860d0.speaker: shah
b83482b860d0.text: Like a little star. I don't guess, Ray. I just notice.

985ce85b8067.speaker: shah
985ce85b8067.text: He had a nice face. Find out who he made it at, last.

439f61cff36c.speaker: charlie
439f61cff36c.text: Ah! Lights, at last! Are you the man in charge? You look like the man in charge of being tired.

8bc1aedc6ab1.speaker: charlie
8bc1aedc6ab1.text: Lyle! Oh, that's not Lyle. That's Lyle's understudy.

075a4e1d5124.speaker: charlie
075a4e1d5124.text: On the boulevard, Charlie. To the IRS, Desmond Pike. Thirty-one years in the forecourt.

873e3dc4abbc.speaker: charlie
873e3dc4abbc.text: I've been in more tourists' photographs than the Pope.

8c9bb60cc3a9.speaker: charlie
8c9bb60cc3a9.text: I came home at midnight. At one I came out for my pipe, as I do.

889a4bd87398.speaker: charlie
889a4bd87398.text: Pearl's little yellow Fiat was down in the alley, behind Gus's back door. I thought, he's working that poor girl late again.

97dd45d40b2f.speaker: charlie
97dd45d40b2f.text: My pipe keeps better time than the studio. One o'clock, one pipe. Like Gus and his cigar.

453ff399a12f.speaker: charlie
453ff399a12f.text: Half past one, perhaps. Gus, up here, shouting. "How long? How long?" Over and over.

f18ddb10117e.speaker: charlie
f18ddb10117e.text: I couldn't hear who he was shouting at. The rain, and I'm seventy-three, and I'd gone inside. Then nothing. I thought, good, they've made up.

58d2c39f62ce.speaker: charlie
58d2c39f62ce.text: Thirty years. He sold me this derby. Told me it was Chaplin's own. It wasn't. He told me that too, after I'd paid.

59f50b2879b0.speaker: charlie
59f50b2879b0.text: No. Don't tell Pearl anything. She was always kind to me.

9286c5476bfb.speaker: charlie
9286c5476bfb.text: Him again? I told you. Big fellow, cop's shoes. Empty by Christmas.

e0540c6412bc.speaker: charlie
e0540c6412bc.text: Him. Big fellow, old raincoat, cop's shoes. Last Thursday he went door to door, handing those out like a priest with wafers.

8dbdfbbd11cf.speaker: charlie
8dbdfbbd11cf.text: Said the whole block would be empty by Christmas. "The jazz club too," he said. As if it were good news.

4b46caff0267.speaker: charlie
4b46caff0267.text: The Blue Note, round the corner. You can see the sign from here. Gus told him to go to hell. In Swedish, so it took longer.

765ccf0f6190.speaker: ray
765ccf0f6190.text: Can't see my own feet. There's a sign up here the size of a bus. It must have a switch.

923e13f39d55.speaker: ray
923e13f39d55.text: Lovely. Now the rain is purple.

6172590e763a.speaker: ray
6172590e763a.text: Can't see my own feet. There's a sign up here the size of a bus. It must have a switch somewhere.

d33c14c51489.speaker: ray
d33c14c51489.text: I'm not walking around a roof blind. Gus already showed me how that ends.

8a9e4b5e72e2.speaker: ray
8a9e4b5e72e2.text: Gus's roof. A lawn chair, a coffee can of cigar ends, and the best seat on the boulevard.

81cae882994a.speaker: ray
81cae882994a.text: Charlie Chaplin, smoking a pipe on a fire escape in the rain. Hollywood never closes.

7aca96195494.speaker: ray
7aca96195494.text: S-T-A-R-D-U-S-T, six feet tall. The U's been flickering since the eighties. Gus said it was winking.

8924ed974bfa.speaker: ray
8924ed974bfa.text: I'll leave it on. Somebody should, tonight.

0cd77883ab33.speaker: ray
0cd77883ab33.text: An old wooden water tank on steel legs. Nobody's drunk out of it since the Rams left town the first time.

3c9f3e28579b.speaker: ray
3c9f3e28579b.text: The ladder's wet, and somebody's scraped the rust off the hatch latch.

6bcda27a3fd0.speaker: ray
6bcda27a3fd0.text: Water and rust. Nothing else in there. I looked.

f8cb5d80f04c.speaker: ray
f8cb5d80f04c.text: Little heel prints in the wet gravel, pressed deep. From the roof door to the water tank, and back again.

0108e8133494.speaker: ray
0108e8133494.text: Something gold, right at the top of the stairs. A little star, five points, the post bent back.

e579b0e2e4bb.speaker: ray
e579b0e2e4bb.text: Gus's chair. His cigar's in the puddle beside it, half smoked.

a4fd4080ca6b.speaker: ray
a4fd4080ca6b.text: He came up here to wait for somebody, and he didn't get to finish.

a0d8c083b54f.speaker: ray
a0d8c083b54f.text: I've been standing all night. I'll keep standing.

a4f5b486f0b7.speaker: ray
a4f5b486f0b7.text: Thirty years of cigar ends. Gus was a creature of habit. So was the person who knew where to find him.

9fdc6bd52dd6.speaker: ray
9fdc6bd52dd6.text: Empty by Christmas. The jazz club too.

51a35536a3c9.speaker: ray
51a35536a3c9.text: Two roofs over, a blue neon sign: BLUE NOTE. From up here it's just around the corner.

42441e8dea2c.speaker: ray
42441e8dea2c.text: The pagoda roof across the street. Under it, a hundred years of hands and feet in cement, waiting for the tourists.

f2df3701767b.speaker: ray
f2df3701767b.text: Nothing goes off this roof tonight.

bd215b984964.speaker: ray
bd215b984964.text: A long drop to a wet, empty alley. No yellow Fiat now.

e5ff3bf02b37.speaker: ray
e5ff3bf02b37.text: Gus didn't go off the edge. He went down the stairs.

f6a473a28be3.speaker: ray
f6a473a28be3.text: Neon light slides across black water a foot below the rim. Something floats face down in it, gold, like a drowned starlet.

63a8f110c2e0.speaker: ray
63a8f110c2e0.text: Lyle Brandt. Best Supporting Actor, 1954. Floating.

c62ac437a773.speaker: ray
c62ac437a773.text: It comes up far too easily. Eight and a half pounds of metal doesn't float. This is resin, hollow as a promise.

ccd2b6286e7f.speaker: ray
ccd2b6286e7f.text: Morty said they'd float in a bathtub.

60b6248f3ab8.speaker: ray
60b6248f3ab8.text: No. 734 engraved on the base, and the cuts still shine. Somebody had this made.

7f0dfa113479.speaker: ray
7f0dfa113479.text: Nobody stole Lyle tonight. Lyle left three weeks ago.

e5cea052cbff.speaker: ray
e5cea052cbff.text: Somebody hid this one up here to make a robbery out of it, because nobody walks down Hollywood Boulevard at two in the morning with a gold statue under their arm.

71531bb0eea7.speaker: morty
71531bb0eea7.text: Is that... that's a prop. Give it here.

d0654349ed8e.speaker: morty
d0654349ed8e.text: Two pounds. Gus would've known in a second.

4f5770a5d9ea.speaker: morty
4f5770a5d9ea.text: Is it gone? Tell me it's not gone.

404644013fb7.speaker: morty
404644013fb7.text: I'm not going anywhere, young lady. I've known Gus fifty years.

895fdeaf5bce.speaker: morty
895fdeaf5bce.text: Morty Kahn. Kahn's Collectibles, three doors down. Gus and I have been fighting over the same estate sales since Nixon.

d299ff38d6e3.speaker: morty
d299ff38d6e3.text: Wanted it? In March I offered him two hundred fifty thousand dollars. Cash. He said he'd be buried with it.

7ad40747ebcc.speaker: morty
7ad40747ebcc.text: Upstairs, in my pajamas, losing a Kurosawa script to a dentist in Osaka. Look.

ef1c8afa3b22.speaker: morty
ef1c8afa3b22.text: Two hours of my life. I came down when I saw the lights.

096212903716.speaker: morty
096212903716.text: Eight and a half pounds. Solid britannium, gold plate. You could stop a door with it.

81a5c7404885.speaker: morty
81a5c7404885.text: The props they sell on this boulevard are hollow resin, two pounds. They'd float in your bathtub.

7be64137f129.speaker: morty
7be64137f129.text: Find who did this. And whatever was in that case, I want to know what it was.

8bcefb557994.speaker: morty
8bcefb557994.text: It was me. All right? Me.

9e0c0af7cee9.speaker: morty
9e0c0af7cee9.text: A broker at Calloway's called. A collection selling quietly, no names. I wired a hundred and eighty thousand to something called Stardust Archive.

d69b1161675d.speaker: morty
d69b1161675d.text: I thought the eviction finally broke him. Too proud to sell to me to my face, so I let him not. I never said a word.

64cadbe92d8c.speaker: morty
64cadbe92d8c.text: Fifty years, and I never said a word.

15cd8ba4fdfc.speaker: morty
15cd8ba4fdfc.text: It's in my safe right now, Detective. It's real. I'd know.

c5d6a48b3d46.speaker: morty
c5d6a48b3d46.text: Gus? Gus thought email was a fad. The girl does it. Pearl. The website, the listings, everything with a screen.

4cce8df381b7.speaker: morty
4cce8df381b7.text: Was it real? The one in the case?

060dc4c43fe7.speaker: morty
060dc4c43fe7.text: He said he'd be buried with it.

4bf6ae74015c.speaker: park
4bf6ae74015c.text: Gus Lindqvist, seventy-one, the owner. He's in back, at the bottom of the roof stairs. Dr. Shah's with him.

ccad4887c9c5.speaker: park
ccad4887c9c5.text: The 911 call came in at two-nineteen from his assistant, Pearl Danvers. I got here at two twenty-six. The door was like that, and the case was empty.

9dd72cc39709.speaker: park
9dd72cc39709.text: Morty Kahn. Owns the collectibles shop three doors down. He came out when he saw the lights.

71aed551c62f.speaker: park
71aed551c62f.text: He keeps asking if "it" is gone. I don't think he means Mr. Lindqvist.

c493fb8cca6e.speaker: park
c493fb8cca6e.text: The boulevard's shut. There's a Charlie Chaplin who lives next door. He's out on his fire escape, and he says he'll only talk to "the man in charge."

2a38dff3e807.speaker: park
2a38dff3e807.text: Tonight it is. You can see his fire escape from Mr. Lindqvist's roof.

5fef14d8e428.speaker: park
5fef14d8e428.text: Already asked. Miss Danvers mentioned him. Pryce has a night security desk; the supervisor sent me stills in four minutes.

c9951ee2c383.speaker: park
c9951ee2c383.text: Whitaker's car went into the Pryce Tower garage in Century City at ten fifty-eight. He's on their elevator camera at three-oh-two a.m., still in his tie.

a9436cd798d4.speaker: park
a9436cd798d4.text: He said they "always cooperate with the department." Like he'd said it before.

a4ed32dc901a.speaker: park
a4ed32dc901a.text: I'll keep the door, Detective. Mr. Kahn keeps trying to come in.

fddf7b2e5316.speaker: park
fddf7b2e5316.text: Pearl Danvers. Stand up for me, please.

25573b65b12a.speaker: pearl
25573b65b12a.text: Those are Gus's. Please put them away.

d10e2dd8964c.speaker: pearl
d10e2dd8964c.text: Are you the detective? They keep saying "the detective's coming," like it's a casting call.

81508de34bc3.speaker: pearl
81508de34bc3.text: Sorry. I'm sorry. I don't know what I'm saying.

5e817c75a63d.speaker: pearl
5e817c75a63d.text: We closed at nine. I went home. I've got an audition at nine this morning, a pharmacy ad, "concerned mom", and I left my headshots in my locker.

dd4cce9d20cd.speaker: pearl
dd4cce9d20cd.text: So I came back. Two-fifteen, maybe? The door was smashed. Lyle was gone. And Gus was at the bottom of the stairs. I called 911.

18ffffa6f93f.speaker: pearl
18ffffa6f93f.text: Six years. I came in to sell him a lobby card from my grandmother's attic, and he gave me a job instead. Said I had an eye.

684e625fc65d.speaker: pearl
684e625fc65d.text: Gus has one. I have one. That's it. Gus didn't let anyone else near Lyle.

56d76418ca1d.speaker: pearl
56d76418ca1d.text: Lyle Brandt. The Oscar. Gus called it by name. "Morning, Lyle. Night, Lyle."

b74bf7b7ba00.speaker: pearl
b74bf7b7ba00.text: Everybody. Morty out there's been begging Gus for years. And the developer. Pryce.

4a886380b152.speaker: pearl
4a886380b152.text: Their man Whitaker was here yesterday yelling that Gus had thirty days. Gus told him to put it in writing, and he said it already was.

327d407a547f.speaker: pearl
327d407a547f.text: Okay. Okay! He called. He was upset, he'd seen something in a catalogue, he wasn't making sense. So I came in. At one.

c0f92d12b647.speaker: pearl
c0f92d12b647.text: We talked in the office, he calmed down, he went up for his cigar, and I went home. And at two he wasn't answering, so I came back, and...

2c182a31ea00.speaker: pearl
2c182a31ea00.text: You found him! Where was he?

09d97c285a55.speaker: pearl
09d97c285a55.text: Yes. Okay. Yes. I sold things. I sold Lyle.

165d622f5409.speaker: pearl
165d622f5409.text: But I didn't hurt him. When I got here at one, he was already at the bottom of the stairs. He'd fallen.

e25dd2bae18d.speaker: pearl
e25dd2bae18d.text: He's seventy-one, he goes up there in the rain in his slippers. And I thought, they'll look at the case, and then they'll look at me, and I'll go to prison for a fall.

8a74bbae9b43.speaker: pearl
8a74bbae9b43.text: So I made it a robbery. That's all I did. I swear to God, that's all I did.

9057569a4ba8.speaker: pearl
9057569a4ba8.text: He kept saying "How long? How long?" So I told him. Eighteen months. A Bogart letter first, for rent. Then the photos. Then Lyle.

87b1db98331c.speaker: pearl
87b1db98331c.text: I'm good, you know? I'm good at being somebody else. It's the only thing I've ever been good at.

a44a7c3b088d.speaker: pearl
a44a7c3b088d.text: He said he'd call the police in the morning. He took my arm, and his hand caught my earring, and it tore, and it hurt, and I just...

6eeec90ff0ce.speaker: pearl
6eeec90ff0ce.text: I put my hands on him. To get him off me. And then he wasn't there. He was just gone. Down the stairs. One slipper.

e88be7a699a1.speaker: pearl
e88be7a699a1.text: I'm thirty-four. I've died on four cop shows. Corpse number two. I've never had a line that wasn't a scream.

06dcea838231.speaker: ray
06dcea838231.text: Stardust Memorabilia. Sixty years of other people's dreams, sold by the square inch.

3c056af87d60.speaker: ray
3c056af87d60.text: Officer Park. Same rain cape, still in the neighborhood.

982ae02aceb8.speaker: ray
982ae02aceb8.text: She's holding the door, not the evidence.

a74fe5e64a64.speaker: ray
a74fe5e64a64.text: Bathrobe, loafers, no socks. He keeps looking past me at the empty case.

57fa13464c36.speaker: ray
57fa13464c36.text: He's seen it. He's living it.

a11a455f4840.speaker: ray
a11a455f4840.text: An empty velvet bed shaped like a statue. A brass plate: "Lyle Brandt. Best Supporting Actor, 1954. Harbor Lights."

1ccf83b72585.speaker: ray
1ccf83b72585.text: The little brass key turns like butter. Same kind Pearl wears around her neck.

49fac343f78e.speaker: ray
49fac343f78e.text: The lock's clean. No scratches, no pry marks, and the glass is whole. Somebody opened this with a key.

a504a3fde273.speaker: ray
a504a3fde273.text: Opened with a key. Lyle didn't let himself out.

b5e6158d8608.speaker: ray
b5e6158d8608.text: "Academy Award statuette, Best Supporting Actor, 1954. Lyle Brandt, Harbor Lights. Base serial No. 734. From the Brandt estate, 1988."

6236afc32cc4.speaker: ray
6236afc32cc4.text: The glass in the door is smashed. Most of it is out on the sidewalk, on the star of a TV cowboy nobody remembers.

e64e78b6af2c.speaker: ray
e64e78b6af2c.text: Break into a shop and the glass lands inside. This glass went out.

11f17402befb.speaker: ray
11f17402befb.text: Smashed. Rain's coming through the hole.

d72dc6b11747.speaker: ray
d72dc6b11747.text: Not yet. Gus is still at the bottom of the stairs.

f83d7f3e9a9f.speaker: ray
f83d7f3e9a9f.text: Forty years of Hollywood, signed. Bogart, Monroe, Lyle Brandt, and a dozen faces only Gus remembered.

76f078e8336e.speaker: ray
76f078e8336e.text: Gus would've spotted a fake across the room. If he ever looked.

2001d4ede651.speaker: ray
2001d4ede651.text: An old brass register. Drawer shut.

5b877798d246.speaker: ray
5b877798d246.text: Two hundred twelve dollars and a roll of quarters. A thief who smashes a door and leaves the cash.

8e434304abce.speaker: ray
8e434304abce.text: STARDUST, stenciled on the canvas. Nobody's in it now.

23a4109f3cf5.speaker: ray
23a4109f3cf5.text: A black bird statuette tagged "Not THE bird. A bird. $40." Gus had a sense of humor.

64d3dd770c5f.speaker: ray
64d3dd770c5f.text: The Chinese Theatre across the street, dark. The forecourt's handprints full of rain.

766b6329694a.speaker: ray
766b6329694a.text: Glass out on the sidewalk. The case opened with a key. Nobody broke in here.

d3b424dd1fce.speaker: ray
d3b424dd1fce.text: Somebody with a key broke out, and wanted it to look the other way.

af52a33fdb55.speaker: ray
af52a33fdb55.text: One number, two statues. Only one of them was real.

a5fa78753445.speaker: ray
a5fa78753445.text: Calloway's: "Base serial No. 734. Sold by private treaty." Three weeks ago. Gus's certificate: No. 734.

b56c787c1a5e.speaker: ray
b56c787c1a5e.text: Every Oscar since 1949 has its own number, like a badge.

85166b974d3e.speaker: ray
85166b974d3e.text: One statue, two places. Either Calloway's sold a fake, or Gus was saying good night to one.

f307682cb811.speaker: ray
f307682cb811.text: And since 1950, winners sign a paper: if you sell it, the Academy gets first refusal for a dollar. Nobody sells one in public. That's why it went quiet.

2ff9c202ce07.speaker: ray
2ff9c202ce07.text: Old ink sits dark under UV. Most of these do.

981b8b04120d.speaker: ray
981b8b04120d.text: Three light up like a premiere: Lyle Brandt, Bogart, Monroe. All the same gold.

d9413bd77835.speaker: ray
d9413bd77835.text: Modern paint pen, not old fountain ink. Good fakes, and new ones.

922461ccf87e.speaker: ray
922461ccf87e.text: There's an eviction notice on Gus's desk from Pryce Development. Their man's Trent Whitaker. Where was he tonight?

058a99a2430f.speaker: ray
058a99a2430f.text: Four minutes. Nobody's that helpful at three in the morning.

546e2961ded0.speaker: ray
546e2961ded0.text: Calloway's private sales, three weeks ago. Lyle Brandt's Oscar, serial number 734. Somebody bought it, Morty.

acf3714b91a1.speaker: ray
acf3714b91a1.text: The one in your safe is.

f3a22a4509a8.speaker: ray
f3a22a4509a8.text: Then you know what to do, Morty.

3d979556b80b.speaker: ray
3d979556b80b.text: One gold star in her right ear. Under the hair, the left lobe's bare, torn and red.

b9533ffdd2cf.speaker: ray
b9533ffdd2cf.text: Pearl Danvers. Patrol blanket, hair down over one side of her face. An hour of crying and her mascara hasn't moved.

0600f6bf1798.speaker: ray
0600f6bf1798.text: She's had enough things shoved at her tonight.

335f973d30fc.speaker: ray
335f973d30fc.text: Ray Kessler. Take your time, Miss Danvers.

0b67591732ca.speaker: ray
0b67591732ca.text: Two in the morning, for headshots.

fc294a2b5f00.speaker: ray
fc294a2b5f00.text: Gus called you at twelve fifty-two. Three minutes.

bd1f7726507d.speaker: ray
bd1f7726507d.text: You came back at two in the morning for your headshots. They're in your locker, Pearl. All twenty.

36ebf7c5df6a.speaker: ray
36ebf7c5df6a.text: She's seen him. She knows where he's been.

5077585d4b66.speaker: ray
5077585d4b66.text: Lyle was in the water tank on the roof. He floats, Pearl. Real ones don't.

76bf060a0128.speaker: ray
76bf060a0128.text: The real one went through Calloway's three weeks ago. A buyer wired a hundred and eighty thousand dollars to "Stardust Archive". You run the shop's email.

d0b82e86f832.speaker: ray
d0b82e86f832.text: The real one went through Calloway's three weeks ago.

03b9b2fdd457.speaker: ray
03b9b2fdd457.text: Nobody broke in. You opened the case with your key, broke the glass from the inside, and put Lyle where nobody would look.

8b38265c4ef9.speaker: ray
8b38265c4ef9.text: Because you couldn't carry him down the boulevard past every camera in Hollywood.

2d5421125ed0.speaker: ray
2d5421125ed0.text: That's a better story. It's still a story.

65902181238f.speaker: ray
65902181238f.text: She'll have a reason for that. Let her run out of reasons first.

5bd2bf0a564b.speaker: ray
5bd2bf0a564b.text: Gus didn't fall. He went down those stairs backward, with the heels of two small hands on his chest.

3eb6a85d1bc0.speaker: ray
3eb6a85d1bc0.text: And in his right palm there's a scratch shaped like a little star.

61e012693288.speaker: ray
61e012693288.text: It was at the top of his stairs, Pearl. Push your hair back.

c4ae040fffd0.speaker: ray
c4ae040fffd0.text: Her left earlobe is torn and red.

29728bf08bd3.speaker: ray
29728bf08bd3.text: Gus thought so. For six years.

5671f055884c.speaker: ray
5671f055884c.text: Forty years of fakes and favorites, and a note on a lamp that said trust nobody.

b584d1ea741e.speaker: ray
b584d1ea741e.text: Who's the man in the bathrobe?

7251fd6f14b2.speaker: ray
7251fd6f14b2.text: What does a real one weigh?

10bfaad9aa5b.speaker: ray
10bfaad9aa5b.text: How long did you work for Gus?

8f5bc6f5db39.speaker: ray
8f5bc6f5db39.text: Who has keys to the Oscar case?

dbce40e1522d.speaker: ray
dbce40e1522d.text: Gus called you at twelve fifty-two.

f3c33fccc3f2.speaker: ray
f3c33fccc3f2.text: Your headshots are still in your locker.

d38f86203271.speaker: ray
d38f86203271.text: Lyle was in the water tank.

fab11962227e.speaker: ray
fab11962227e.text: Did he fall, or was he helped?

a4d3e87c9b55.speaker: ray
a4d3e87c9b55.text: She says he fell. Shah says he was pushed. Something of hers says where.

519290f1809d.speaker: ray
519290f1809d.text: Her story keeps getting shorter. Lyle might shorten it more.

fd7e915cb433.speaker: ray
fd7e915cb433.text: Out through the door. I wonder what came out of the case.

590504d4ffb1.speaker: ray
590504d4ffb1.text: Calloway's has a number for Lyle. So does Gus.

73b5274f451d.speaker: ray
73b5274f451d.text: He read that at midnight. Who'd you call, at midnight, with news like that?

dad529c85a2c.speaker: ray
dad529c85a2c.text: Shah's got that look. The one where I haven't asked the right question.

3c45c2ec0874.speaker: ray
3c45c2ec0874.text: I've got what she hid and what she lost. Time to go downstairs and see what she says.

1a89117be9e5.speaker: ray
1a89117be9e5.text: Her heels went to that tank and came back. People don't visit water tanks.

8d2e663fb5c7.speaker: ray
8d2e663fb5c7.text: Room 214. Danny in the middle, Kenji in one corner. Gus gets the other.

472bb6999888.speaker: ray
472bb6999888.text: Not yet. Gus is waiting on the board.

b1b40e296333.speaker: ray
b1b40e296333.text: Quarter to four. The hour when even the coffee gives up.

6907325c0e8b.speaker: ray
6907325c0e8b.text: Danny in the middle, Kenji and Gus in the corners. Three faces, one night.

004cc6eb2173.speaker: ray
004cc6eb2173.text: Seventy-one years, fourteen stairs, and two small hands. Whose?

e5ff184295ef.speaker: ray
e5ff184295ef.text: Morty had the real Lyle in his safe. You don't kill a man over the copy.

969ba86d22c9.speaker: ray
969ba86d22c9.text: Morty spent the night losing to a dentist in Osaka.

2253845ca131.speaker: ray
2253845ca131.text: Morty wanted it. Wanting isn't pushing. And I never asked where he was.

ad4b985b5f6f.speaker: ray
ad4b985b5f6f.text: Whitaker was in a Century City elevator in his tie. And a letter with twenty-three days to run doesn't need a push.

6eb4b2a90a9e.speaker: ray
6eb4b2a90a9e.text: Pryce sent a letter. A letter isn't a pair of hands. I never checked where Whitaker was.

f4de1efbe75e.speaker: ray
f4de1efbe75e.text: A burglar who breaks out, uses a key, leaves the cash and hides the loot on the roof? That's not a burglar. That's a stage manager.

8379c01c7250.speaker: ray
8379c01c7250.text: Think, Ray. What was she doing behind his back, and what did she leave at the top of his stairs?

9480559df0bd.speaker: ray
9480559df0bd.text: Pearl Danvers. She sold him the fake, then she sold him the fall.

2a2f2b999800.speaker: ray
2a2f2b999800.text: It was a fake. The killer wasn't.

4b5e440a3c6b.speaker: ray
4b5e440a3c6b.text: Hand him three. He likes numbers.

204ef7110a77.speaker: ray
204ef7110a77.text: Six. Sure. This whole town's full of optimists.

c9a80f2bbd32.speaker: ray
c9a80f2bbd32.text: The river's dry this time of year.

6696b694b8a3.speaker: ray
6696b694b8a3.text: Then it's closed. Why call me?

5db22d269c6b.speaker: doyle
5db22d269c6b.text: Ray. Otis says your Oscar turned up in a water tank.

0d01193a33e3.speaker: doyle
0d01193a33e3.text: The assistant? Hollywood. Everybody's auditioning. Anything on Reyes?

6b45d76010a1.speaker: doyle
6b45d76010a1.text: I see the captain at eight. I'd like to hand him one thing that's finished.

bb9335f1b245.speaker: doyle
bb9335f1b245.text: Go home at six, Ray. That's an order dressed up as advice. *click*

52462fbd352e.speaker: otis
52462fbd352e.text: Ray. You want the good news or the river?

97298ad9855e.speaker: otis
97298ad9855e.text: No. LA River, Elysian Valley, under the Fletcher Drive bridge. Delivery rider, twenty-four, Owen Tate. Down in the channel.

7008166b525a.speaker: otis
7008166b525a.text: That's how they saw him. Uniforms already cuffed a fella from the camp by the bridge. They call him Preacher. The kid's bike was at his tent.

c5f700ceef57.speaker: otis
c5f700ceef57.text: Because the uniforms are happy. When uniforms are happy at four in the morning, somebody ought to check.

ed7f2647599a.speaker: otis
ed7f2647599a.text: And Ray? Preacher's Army. He says he'll only talk to somebody who's been somewhere.

c08b93e436b8.speaker: ray
c08b93e436b8.text: That's what she was doing. I need where she was.

fa3f4c1b92f7.speaker: ray
fa3f4c1b92f7.text: That's where she was. First, why.

bb5cb51e2b99.speaker: ray
bb5cb51e2b99.text: That proves Lyle was sold. Who sold him?

4bb51da7a14a.speaker: ray
4bb51da7a14a.text: Fakes on the wall. Whose hand?

f837fc0b2699.speaker: ray
f837fc0b2699.text: That's when he called her. I need why.

6040877d07fa.speaker: ray
6040877d07fa.text: That's what she did after. I need the top of the stairs.

199465beffb6.speaker: ray
199465beffb6.text: That's how he went down. Whose hands?

8edaae718831.speaker: ray
8edaae718831.text: Small heels. Half of Hollywood wears small heels.

f15cd034f1e1.speaker: ray
f15cd034f1e1.text: That's Charlie's eyes and ears. I want something Pearl left behind.

cce9cb6932fd.speaker: ray
cce9cb6932fd.text: That proves the robbery was a show. I need who killed him.

0eba374b6c02.speaker: ray
0eba374b6c02.text: That's a lie about her pictures. I'm pinning the truth about Gus.

61c451a650ff.speaker: ray
61c451a650ff.text: That's her story. It's had three drafts.

58fdfac53e2b.speaker: ray
58fdfac53e2b.text: That's Pryce's business. This one was personal.

a09cc6554a9e.speaker: ray
a09cc6554a9e.text: That's Morty. Morty didn't do it.

9eb9b2440a8c.speaker: ray
9eb9b2440a8c.text: That's when, and why he was up there. The board wants who.

515022b4faa6.speaker: ray
515022b4faa6.text: That's a man who wanted Gus out. Gus went out another way.

e0214639f3cc.speaker: ray
e0214639f3cc.text: Gus's key ring. A door key, a desk key, and a little brass one, like the key Pearl wears.

3f9d2e4b1a54.speaker: ray
3f9d2e4b1a54.text: A little gold star, five points, the post bent back. Torn out of somebody's ear.

5b1da59a26c2.speaker: otis
5b1da59a26c2.text: Room 214. The night is young and so am I.

ae6d155447d5.speaker: otis
ae6d155447d5.text: Registered to an Elliot Crane, Mount Washington. Crane, Crane... Ray, that's Councilman Haskell's chief of staff.

598ef0d10961.speaker: otis
598ef0d10961.text: He's on the news every time Haskell won't comment.

9f8800390e2b.speaker: otis
9f8800390e2b.text: You're about to ruin a whole lot of mornings.

15753f0e3a64.speaker: ray
15753f0e3a64.text: The Los Angeles River. Most people in this town don't know it's there. The ones who do mostly live under it.

6a0d817e029a.speaker: ray
6a0d817e029a.text: A kid on a bike, a man in a tent, and a patrol cop who wants to be home by five. Somebody's going to be disappointed.

5bb96d5f17cf.speaker: ray
5bb96d5f17cf.text: Up the hill, where the delivery ended and the party didn't.

8e8c661c9d1d.speaker: ray
8e8c661c9d1d.text: Mount Washington. The kind of hill where the streets give up and become stairs.

13688e234a92.speaker: ray
13688e234a92.text: One stop on the way. Danny's waited two nights; he can wait for a red light.

0c6951bbde4e.speaker: ray
0c6951bbde4e.text: Run a plate for me. Eight, K, X, D, three, nine, two. Blue-gray Audi.

eb95fc634536.speaker: ray
eb95fc634536.text: He's about to be on it again.

ce6ad6a9b04e.speaker: ray
ce6ad6a9b04e.text: Owen Tate's mother's already up. Send Doss to meet me there. Tell him to bring his cuffs. He's had them on the wrong man all night.

2f1bca22beaa.speaker: crane
2f1bca22beaa.text: Can I help you? It's four in the morning.

6072806e698b.speaker: crane
6072806e698b.text: The car washes are closed at four in the morning, Detective.

7dba21f78b1e.speaker: crane
7dba21f78b1e.text: I've got a box of those. Do you want one signed?

5713c5f73943.speaker: crane
5713c5f73943.text: That's my property, Detective. I'd like a warrant before you undress my car.

871e6f92e1f5.speaker: crane
871e6f92e1f5.text: At a fundraiser for the councilman. I'm Councilmember Haskell's chief of staff.

f6f3f0276488.speaker: crane
f6f3f0276488.text: A car service. I'd had a glass of wine; I'm responsible. The Audi's been in here all evening.

b2277b0f5fdd.speaker: crane
b2277b0f5fdd.text: Birds. There's a jacaranda. Would you like to see the jacaranda, Detective?

b9668c3a780b.speaker: crane
b9668c3a780b.text: All right. I drove. I'd had two glasses. Three. I was fine. I drove home slowly.

19373793c79b.speaker: crane
19373793c79b.text: And on Avenue 43 a coyote ran out. A big one. I hit it.

350a735fab99.speaker: crane
350a735fab99.text: There. That's what the tarp's for. I didn't want the neighbors seeing it and thinking I'd done something.

40fd48f61ae7.speaker: crane
40fd48f61ae7.text: Okay. Okay. Something hit me. On the bridge. A shape, in the rain, in the dark.

cebf7c025d45.speaker: crane
cebf7c025d45.text: I didn't stop. I panicked, I drove home. I didn't know it was a person until I saw it on the news.

7b800ab09c48.speaker: crane
7b800ab09c48.text: He was right there at the end of the bridge. In the road. I got out. I thought I'd help. I thought...

25359d0f92d1.speaker: crane
25359d0f92d1.text: And I knew him. That's the thing. I knew him. The kid from the gate. "You can't drive like that."

7f866ae652d4.speaker: crane
7f866ae652d4.text: And I looked down, and there were tents. And I thought, nobody looks twice at that river. Nobody looks twice at those people.

8cc1209f2ddf.speaker: crane
8cc1209f2ddf.text: Do you know what Wednesday is? The council votes on Hollywood Core. Ted's the swing vote.

8f3e7c5e1273.speaker: crane
8f3e7c5e1273.text: Eleven years I've carried that man's briefcase. If his chief of staff is a DUI story on Friday morning, they postpone, and Harlan...

7d08eb3421c8.speaker: crane
7d08eb3421c8.text: Mr. Pryce has been a good friend to the district.

39b5a33c4cb0.speaker: doss
39b5a33c4cb0.text: Detective. Otis said you've got somebody who deserves these more.

cf44da908663.speaker: doss
cf44da908663.text: I had a vet in my car for this. A guy who fought in a war.

0ce0ac38c699.speaker: ray
0ce0ac38c699.text: Mount Washington. The houses hang off the hill like they're waiting to be asked in.

b4bf9a87cff4.speaker: ray
b4bf9a87cff4.text: Detective Kessler, LAPD. You're washing your car at four in the morning, Mr. Crane.

1ac65f76128b.speaker: ray
1ac65f76128b.text: Elliot Crane, on the step to his own house, with nowhere left to go up.

e96f3a987801.speaker: ray
e96f3a987801.text: Elliot Crane. A robe over his suit trousers and a face that's been rehearsing since two o'clock.

9e9fbe2d1fa3.speaker: ray
9e9fbe2d1fa3.text: Not his. Not his kind of trouble.

ebcc40d3b260.speaker: ray
ebcc40d3b260.text: He'd only argue with it. The car won't.

12ac020f499e.speaker: ray
12ac020f499e.text: A blue tarp, still creased in squares from the package. Price sticker on the corner: $19.99. It's new tonight.

4f054c5d5b39.speaker: ray
4f054c5d5b39.text: Not yet. Let him take the tarp off himself.

aa299ba9f2cd.speaker: ray
aa299ba9f2cd.text: A blue-gray A6, washed till it shines. Right headlight gone, a dent in the hood.

c0795b6467f6.speaker: ray
c0795b6467f6.text: I'm not touching it till the lab does.

b1de1c15c2ca.speaker: ray
b1de1c15c2ca.text: A black hole with jagged edges, the shape of the pieces in my pocket.

01e6c0255bc2.speaker: ray
01e6c0255bc2.text: Washed, mostly. Deep in the seam of the grille, a smear of yellow. Chomp yellow.

fdf8418a3d51.speaker: ray
fdf8418a3d51.text: The hose has been running into the drain long enough to make a stream. Somebody's been washing a car for two hours.

3dd72d00e2bd.speaker: ray
3dd72d00e2bd.text: I'll let it run. It's not my water bill.

32ac720bc970.speaker: ray
32ac720bc970.text: Italian loafers on a sheet of newspaper, soaked through. Gray-green river mud packed in the stitching, and a fluff of reed seed stuck to one heel.

113cd8e9c193.speaker: ray
113cd8e9c193.text: Nobody gets river mud on their shoes driving home from Los Feliz.

1c92f65f60e6.speaker: ray
1c92f65f60e6.text: They stay where they are. The lab will want them wet.

04ce79aba61e.speaker: ray
04ce79aba61e.text: Everybody's up late in Council District 13.

7949a6640e3f.speaker: ray
7949a6640e3f.text: It's locked, and it's his. The lock screen's chatty enough.

f94242bb55eb.speaker: ray
f94242bb55eb.text: A good suit on a hook. A name badge on the lapel: ELLIOT CRANE, OFFICE OF COUNCILMEMBER TED HASKELL.

56bfdfba7a60.speaker: ray
56bfdfba7a60.text: Up to the house. The lights upstairs are off. Somebody up there is sleeping through this.

54a1fcc26361.speaker: ray
54a1fcc26361.text: I'm not going in. Everything I need is down here.

bd2900cef143.speaker: ray
bd2900cef143.text: A street so steep the parked cars are holding on.

76a079a532a6.speaker: ray
76a079a532a6.text: Not yet. Mr. Crane and I aren't done.

ef89de9de8c1.speaker: ray
ef89de9de8c1.text: He says it like a badge.

79df70474f2c.speaker: ray
79df70474f2c.text: You'll know it when it gets here.

fea4e256abb0.speaker: ray
fea4e256abb0.text: He's seen it. He's moved on to coyotes.

cc224b9c6b8d.speaker: ray
cc224b9c6b8d.text: Starline Valet, ticket forty-seven. "Crane. Out one fifty-five. Guest insisted."

3735a48c5b2c.speaker: ray
3735a48c5b2c.text: There's a camera on Mr. Pryce's gate. It has you taking your own keys off the board at one fifty-one, and a delivery rider telling you that you can't drive like that.

fdd6e871beea.speaker: ray
fdd6e871beea.text: He puts the glass down on the bench, very carefully.

29e5a4f0585a.speaker: ray
29e5a4f0585a.text: Washed and gleaming. The right headlight is a black hole with jagged edges. A shallow dent in the hood.

dd1ea5f445ec.speaker: ray
dd1ea5f445ec.text: He'd tell me it's his car and his garage. Let him show it to me.

95ddd9271eb1.speaker: ray
95ddd9271eb1.text: Both pieces fit. The rings line up. Nothing more to prove with plastic.

e42b15b894ad.speaker: ray
e42b15b894ad.text: A black hole where a headlight was. The rest of it's somewhere between here and Los Feliz.

5353c5a54e76.speaker: ray
5353c5a54e76.text: It fits, almost. There's a sliver still missing. Owen's bike had something of it.

8330fdaa3122.speaker: ray
8330fdaa3122.text: The two pieces settle into the hole, and the four rings moulded into the plastic join up across the break as if they'd never left.

16d1dcf22595.speaker: ray
16d1dcf22595.text: This piece was in the reeds under the Fletcher Drive bridge. This one was in a delivery box on Owen Tate's bike.

d512c4867186.speaker: ray
d512c4867186.text: They fit your headlight like a key, Mr. Crane. Coyotes don't carry headlights into the river.

8467b314f91d.speaker: ray
8467b314f91d.text: And there's Chomp yellow in your grille.

d7ac4dd4f9b8.speaker: ray
d7ac4dd4f9b8.text: He had a yellow box the size of a television on his back with a red light blinking on it.

9867150b3685.speaker: ray
9867150b3685.text: And there isn't any news, Mr. Crane. Nobody's found him on the news. They found him in the river.

9b2edeca4d2a.speaker: ray
9b2edeca4d2a.text: He says he didn't stop. Something in this garage got out of the car.

577eeb50a6c3.speaker: ray
577eeb50a6c3.text: You stopped. Your shoes are on the bench, Mr. Crane. Five-hundred-dollar loafers with river mud in the stitching and reed seed stuck to the heel.

e4de3da67978.speaker: ray
e4de3da67978.text: And Owen's back is scraped raw from the bank, and it barely bled. He was dead when you slid him down it.

7a920c7ec6ab.speaker: ray
7a920c7ec6ab.text: Owen Tate was twenty-four. He rode nights so he could study nursing in the day. He told you not to drive.

a20d3465a2ea.speaker: ray
a20d3465a2ea.text: Owen Tate was twenty-four. He told you not to drive.

cded225a3acc.speaker: ray
cded225a3acc.text: Elliot Crane. Gross vehicular manslaughter, felony hit and run, and whatever the DA calls what he did after. Read him the rest, Officer.

32f55eb84f4a.speaker: ray
32f55eb84f4a.text: Say it anyway. He told me you already did.

ded447162c13.speaker: ray
ded447162c13.text: The phone on the workbench buzzes again. Nobody answers it.

ef328a06d78a.speaker: doss
ef328a06d78a.text: Detective! Brian Doss, Northeast. Sorry to drag you out. Honestly, it's a wrap. Kid's bike, guy's tent. Coroner's just being thorough.

ff66c84e2727.speaker: doss
ff66c84e2727.text: Glass. Cool. Want an evidence bag?

353fc903a1c7.speaker: doss
353fc903a1c7.text: That's not the kid's. His is on the bike.

38ca07dfe1d0.speaker: doss
38ca07dfe1d0.text: Hands off the unit, Detective. City property.

106f51804ef8.speaker: doss
106f51804ef8.text: Owen Tate, twenty-four, rides for Chomp. He's down on the concrete under the east end. His e-bike was parked at that guy's tent. Two thousand bucks of bike. Guy says he "found it."

a8cec4036acd.speaker: doss
a8cec4036acd.text: Metro bus driver on the owl route, three twenty-two. Saw a yellow bag down in the channel in his headlights and called it in. Good eyes. I'd have missed it.

11df49e4fb9b.speaker: doss
11df49e4fb9b.text: Calvin Odom, they call him Preacher. Army guy, lives under the bridge. Won't say a word to me. Says he'll only talk to "somebody who's been somewhere."

303f5521b4e3.speaker: doss
303f5521b4e3.text: I'll be right here. My shift ends at five, so, you know. No rush.

d3748048422e.speaker: doss
d3748048422e.text: You want me to light up the river? At four in the morning?

d9cbd868b3f3.speaker: preacher
d9cbd868b3f3.text: "...and the waters returned from off the earth continually." Genesis, eight. You're the detective.
d9cbd868b3f3.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

bd758c482fdb.speaker: preacher
bd758c482fdb.text: That young man says I killed a boy for a bicycle. I told him I'd speak to somebody who's been somewhere.
bd758c482fdb.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

dc61799a9f0c.speaker: preacher
dc61799a9f0c.text: I was in my tent with Deuteronomy. Some while after two, I see a red light blinking on the water. Off, on, off, on. Up on the bridge. So I went up the stairs.
dc61799a9f0c.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

b1954dd37463.speaker: preacher
b1954dd37463.text: A bicycle, leaning on the rail, light still going, nobody with it. Big yellow box on the back, all stove in.
b1954dd37463.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

149440244ff1.speaker: preacher
149440244ff1.text: I carried it down. By sunup the strippers would've had the wheels, the battery, the seat. I meant to hand it to the first police I saw.
149440244ff1.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

a4ecc36adf71.speaker: preacher
a4ecc36adf71.text: The first police I saw put me in this car.
a4ecc36adf71.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

a229f58853fc.speaker: preacher
a229f58853fc.text: Two o'clock, about. A bang up top, like a dumpster lid. No brakes before it. I know brakes.
a229f58853fc.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

06b96c1ba38d.speaker: preacher
06b96c1ba38d.text: Then quiet. Then a long while after, a car door. Then a car going away slow, like it was ashamed of itself.
06b96c1ba38d.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

1d437952c68a.speaker: preacher
1d437952c68a.text: Long enough for a man to do something. Not long enough to do it right.
1d437952c68a.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

346e06a8fd0c.speaker: preacher
346e06a8fd0c.text: No, sir. He was on the far side, under the east end, in the dark. If I'd seen him I'd have gone to him.
346e06a8fd0c.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

5eec5d01a303.speaker: preacher
5eec5d01a303.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

3864e67fe8a0.speaker: preacher
3864e67fe8a0.text: Because nobody steals from my camp. That's the rule down there. I'm the rule.
3864e67fe8a0.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

de7a3767e151.speaker: preacher
de7a3767e151.text: I'll be in this car. Unless somebody decides different.
de7a3767e151.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

e4fbc518a861.speaker: preacher
e4fbc518a861.text: The Lord knows I did not. That young man doesn't. Ask me better.
e4fbc518a861.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

b126d8fd9f7f.speaker: preacher
b126d8fd9f7f.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

38fc653800da.speaker: preacher
38fc653800da.text: That's a long time somewhere. It ain't what I asked.
38fc653800da.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

d4ed2b393ffa.speaker: preacher
d4ed2b393ffa.text: A man who's been everywhere has been nowhere twice.
d4ed2b393ffa.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

3bccc475d079.speaker: preacher
3bccc475d079.text: MP. Then you know your motto, MP.
3bccc475d079.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

05748bff74b5.speaker: preacher
05748bff74b5.text: That's a Marine. You don't stand like a Marine.
05748bff74b5.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

3c5567ff391d.speaker: preacher
3c5567ff391d.text: You ain't no Ranger. Rangers don't drink that much coffee.
3c5567ff391d.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

85fe6c52faf0.speaker: preacher
85fe6c52faf0.text: That's painted on your car door. I asked about the Army.
85fe6c52faf0.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

ed8fbf417c55.speaker: preacher
ed8fbf417c55.text: Assist, protect, defend. First Cavalry, Desert Storm. Seventy-two hours to Kuwait City and thirty years to get here.
ed8fbf417c55.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

4c994a7925d9.speaker: preacher
4c994a7925d9.text: Calvin Odom. They call me Preacher because I read to the river.
4c994a7925d9.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

c81c34d1385e.speaker: preacher
c81c34d1385e.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

8f43d13f9d55.speaker: ray
8f43d13f9d55.text: Fletcher Drive. Built in 1927, back when the city still thought the river was worth looking at.

84f7ce9bdc5d.speaker: ray
84f7ce9bdc5d.text: Officer Doss. Happy as a man with a short day ahead of him.

33e67d19bd16.speaker: ray
33e67d19bd16.text: Empty. Doss is pretending he never put anybody in it.

cb3c3c4153e8.speaker: ray
cb3c3c4153e8.text: Preacher, behind the cage. Sitting like he's on parade.

86541f20d4ee.speaker: ray
86541f20d4ee.text: Pointed down at the reeds. Doss is pretending it was his idea.

040e40d02c12.speaker: ray
040e40d02c12.text: A door-mounted spotlight, aimed at the road like it's expecting a parade.

c59a784d976f.speaker: ray
c59a784d976f.text: Wet asphalt, a painted bike lane, and no skid marks. Not one. Whoever hit him never touched the brakes.

18c48d608c70.speaker: ray
18c48d608c70.text: Nothing on the road but rain.

4920b3d054b3.speaker: ray
4920b3d054b3.text: Crumbs of clear plastic in the gutter by the bike lane. Not windshield glass; that breaks into little cubes. This has edges. Headlight.

103bcfcc8770.speaker: ray
103bcfcc8770.text: I'm not feeding it anything else.

2d2e3d936196.speaker: ray
2d2e3d936196.text: A storm drain in the gutter, gurgling.

ad027d0ace9e.speaker: ray
ad027d0ace9e.text: A storm drain, gurgling. Plastic glitter caught in the bars. The rain washed the big pieces down.

f64fff8e8add.speaker: ray
f64fff8e8add.text: Bridges drain straight into the river. Whatever went through that grate came out under the bridge.

50249ea590c3.speaker: ray
50249ea590c3.text: A gap in the chain-link where the bridge meets the bank. The concrete lip is scuffed fresh, and there's a smear in the algae going down.

3ced141b72fa.speaker: ray
3ced141b72fa.text: Too steep for these shoes. Whoever went down here went down hard. I'll take the stairs.

d5adcf278d5b.speaker: ray
d5adcf278d5b.text: Deco railing, ninety-some years old. Somebody leaned a bike on it tonight. Somebody leaned on it Tuesday night, too, and threw something over.

b8b0188de7aa.speaker: ray
b8b0188de7aa.text: Deco railing, ninety-some years old. Somebody leaned a bike on it tonight.

b66e528a160a.speaker: ray
b66e528a160a.text: A long way down to three inches of water.

9342117179f1.speaker: ray
9342117179f1.text: Concrete stairs down into the channel.

04e19844008c.speaker: ray
04e19844008c.text: Globes on iron posts. Half of them are out. The city fixes the other half when somebody important drives over.

a66d5fd10e77.speaker: ray
a66d5fd10e77.text: Not yet. Owen hasn't told me where he'd been.

af0bbe95f00c.speaker: ray
af0bbe95f00c.text: I'll come back with more than a feeling.

13242f31ce38.speaker: ray
13242f31ce38.text: Shah says a car hit that kid from behind, hard enough to break both his legs at bumper height. Your man doesn't have a car.

3bd039363080.speaker: ray
3bd039363080.text: And the bike came down the stairs on one wheel. Owen came down the bank on his heels, dragged. Two trips, two different people.

1f9e37101f9f.speaker: ray
1f9e37101f9f.text: And a man who steals a two-thousand-dollar bike leaves a nine-hundred-dollar phone on the handlebars?

3f1852727fa0.speaker: ray
3f1852727fa0.text: He rubbed his wrists, looked at me, and said nothing. Then he walked down the stairs into the channel, back straight.

68a2de8829b5.speaker: ray
68a2de8829b5.text: Swing your spotlight over the rail. Under the bridge, on the reeds below the drain pipe.

57d92cdbd8f8.speaker: ray
57d92cdbd8f8.text: A hard white beam drops over the railing into the channel, onto a black island of reeds.

d95d87b73445.speaker: ray
d95d87b73445.text: Hands cuffed behind him, a gray beard, an Army field jacket. His lips are moving.

157a76f50409.speaker: ray
157a76f50409.text: Twenty years. They take the motto back with the uniform.

5a47c8684953.speaker: andre
5a47c8684953.text: I wrote it down. I swear I wrote it down.

f7441c17eddd.speaker: andre
f7441c17eddd.text: Sir, I can call you a car...

086bf2e1b4b6.speaker: andre
086bf2e1b4b6.text: Evening, sir. Morning. Are you picking up? I've only got one car left.

7d8af5075efa.speaker: andre
7d8af5075efa.text: I'm not supposed to say. I'm not supposed to give keys to drunk guests. It's policy. I could lose the job.

a924bfc7f148.speaker: andre
a924bfc7f148.text: No! He took them off the board himself. I offered him an Uber. I wrote it on the ticket so it's not on me. That's what they tell you to write.

b48485a31b89.speaker: andre
b48485a31b89.text: A Range Rover. The lady took an Uber like a grown-up. She'll pick it up in the morning.

2fd1f75c6cec.speaker: andre
2fd1f75c6cec.text: The councilman, at eleven, with his wife and a driver. Mr. Pryce too, around eleven. Gray Lincoln.

30bff29c1067.speaker: andre
30bff29c1067.text: He's got his own driver, big old guy, used to be a cop, you can tell. Sat in the car all night with the engine running and never came in. Didn't tip.

d6d8ae7f0688.speaker: andre
d6d8ae7f0688.text: Sir? The delivery guy. He was nice to me. He gave me a spring roll.

47ef2f859b1d.speaker: courtney
47ef2f859b1d.text: No, the chafing dishes go back to Burbank, the linens go to...

8e93c5c3c427.speaker: courtney
8e93c5c3c427.text: We're closed. The event's over. If you're press, it was lovely.

78c8e53ba790.speaker: courtney
78c8e53ba790.text: Oh God. Is this the noise thing? We had a permit.

cca59d8dfc56.speaker: courtney
cca59d8dfc56.text: Mr. Pryce's. Harlan Pryce, Pryce Development. It's his house, well, the company's.

60bfbb560e8a.speaker: courtney
60bfbb560e8a.text: A fundraiser for Councilmember Haskell. Two hundred guests, a string quartet, and a man who gave a forty-minute speech about density.

d95890518a9f.speaker: courtney
d95890518a9f.text: For my crew. Eight pad thai. Forty minutes late and stone cold. The guests eat first. The staff eats last, or not at all.

23c81a260f0f.speaker: courtney
23c81a260f0f.text: He was rude. He was late, and then he stood at my gate lecturing me about my guests. He said somebody was going to get killed.

0e938c5c87ab.speaker: courtney
0e938c5c87ab.text: I'm a woman alone at two in the morning with a gate code, Detective. That's a threat.

3ad4916606af.speaker: courtney
3ad4916606af.text: Watch the one at one fifty-one.

acc62a918f42.speaker: courtney
acc62a918f42.text: Our guest list is confidential. You can call Mr. Pryce's office in the morning.

d4e85f6d97a8.speaker: courtney
d4e85f6d97a8.text: The pad thai was cold because it was raining. I knew that. I knew it then.

1a7cb62b894c.speaker: courtney
1a7cb62b894c.text: He said somebody was going to get killed.

a10b8920fcef.speaker: courtney
a10b8920fcef.text: He didn't mean me. He meant...

5ec5914f8cc8.speaker: courtney
5ec5914f8cc8.text: There's a camera on the gate. Mr. Pryce's people put cameras on everything. I have the app. Here.

3a3d29db90ed.speaker: owen
3a3d29db90ed.text: It's raining, ma'am. The app stacks the orders.

a3c81db73db2.speaker: owen
a3c81db73db2.text: Hey, man. You can't drive like that.

87d01cb1112b.speaker: owen
87d01cb1112b.text: You're gonna let him drive? Somebody's gonna get killed.

6296160ec280.speaker: ray
6296160ec280.text: Los Feliz. Up here the rain falls on a better class of people.

c45579f319b9.speaker: ray
c45579f319b9.text: Courtney Vail, Vail Events. A headset, a clipboard, and a jaw that hasn't unclenched since Labor Day.

8c5d8ae0866d.speaker: ray
8c5d8ae0866d.text: The valet. Nineteen, soaked, still standing up straight.

46cc6347561d.speaker: ray
46cc6347561d.text: A board of hooks. One key left, on a Range Rover fob.

f1e51c9136e4.speaker: ray
f1e51c9136e4.text: It's not my car, and it's not his.

03e2472c9504.speaker: ray
03e2472c9504.text: A camera on the gatepost, red light blinking.

c85d7bb0c235.speaker: ray
c85d7bb0c235.text: A fresh scrape along the curb, and a fleck of blue-gray paint in it.

7eab045643cf.speaker: ray
7eab045643cf.text: "Friends of Ted Haskell. Hollywood Core: The Future Has a Skyline." The future has good lighting.

40eef39504d5.speaker: ray
40eef39504d5.text: I'll leave it for the next party.

ad25630a360e.speaker: ray
ad25630a360e.text: A box of unclaimed gift bags. "Hollywood Core" printed on the side. Rich people leave free things behind the way they leave tips.

a032338ae3ac.speaker: ray
a032338ae3ac.text: A candle, a bottle of olive oil with a councilman's smile on the label, and a card.

10abd308debd.speaker: ray
10abd308debd.text: More candles and more olive oil. One invitation's enough.

2e1af64d8153.speaker: ray
2e1af64d8153.text: Chafing dishes going home to Burbank. Two hundred people ate well tonight.

86b666a9c5c8.speaker: ray
86b666a9c5c8.text: Nothing in there but tomorrow's leftovers.

1d790b67bf23.speaker: ray
1d790b67bf23.text: A glass house on a hill, lit up like a display case. Nobody inside it throws anything.

5de8610e4a86.speaker: ray
5de8610e4a86.text: I'm not invited. I'm never invited.

37e66c3c0a8f.speaker: ray
37e66c3c0a8f.text: The whole basin, down to the port. Somewhere down there, the river.

4fe67a799b36.speaker: ray
4fe67a799b36.text: My car, parked between two Teslas like a stray between show dogs.

bad2bd74ec34.speaker: ray
bad2bd74ec34.text: His name was Owen Tate. He's dead, Ms. Vail. He's under the Fletcher Drive bridge.

7fc0a76436d3.speaker: ray
7fc0a76436d3.text: A car hit him at about two o'clock, ten minutes after he left your gate.

310f2dcd7025.speaker: ray
310f2dcd7025.text: Downhill toward Riverside Drive. Toward the river.

1f2df59482e0.speaker: ray
1f2df59482e0.text: Both headlights at one fifty-five. Two minutes behind a kid on a bike, going the same way, in a hurry.

a747b7e852ac.speaker: ray
a747b7e852ac.text: Did you give him the keys?

541556c31475.speaker: ray
541556c31475.text: Number forty-seven. Audi A6, blue-gray, 8KXD392. Crane. Out one fifty-five. Guest insisted, offered rideshare, declined.

389c78562e3c.speaker: ray
389c78562e3c.text: You wrote it down, Andre. You're the only one up here who did.

9ea1c86fcc84.speaker: ike
9ea1c86fcc84.text: Kessler. You only come here when it's weird.

d6feb7b3d9a4.speaker: ike
d6feb7b3d9a4.text: That's evidence in a different case. Book it properly, I'm not your mom.

b634c83f5ec9.speaker: ike
b634c83f5ec9.text: One hour. I heard you. Go away so I can do it.

d9fd5d2ae152.speaker: ike
d9fd5d2ae152.text: Put something in the tray, Ray. I don't do small talk at this hour. Or any hour.

732fa405e914.speaker: ike
732fa405e914.text: Blue Note sticker. "If found, call the Blue Note."

5ba7b68f8721.speaker: ike
5ba7b68f8721.text: Phones hate rivers. And the rice thing's a myth, before you ask.

d74a9367ba35.speaker: ike
d74a9367ba35.text: The board's probably soup. But nobody's phone lives alone anymore, Ray. If he synced it to anything, a cloud, a laptop, a girlfriend's tablet, I can find where it went.

24e079ab27b4.speaker: ike
24e079ab27b4.text: Nobody ever asks me anything anyway.

d4f87e9bd339.speaker: ike
d4f87e9bd339.text: One drive, hashed and logged. Takes froze the account at five fifty-one; the original sits there until a judge asks for it.

d1e4ac02da04.speaker: ike
d1e4ac02da04.text: My machine forgot it ever met you. And your piano player's phone. It's still dead.

06e5a68f55b8.speaker: ike
06e5a68f55b8.text: Ray. Whatever you're doing at sunrise, do it somewhere with a lot of witnesses.

2b764bdf79e5.speaker: ray
2b764bdf79e5.text: Ike Feld. Nights at the lab for six years. He says the machines are better company.

dbcf8fdc0446.speaker: ray
dbcf8fdc0446.text: A steel tray under the glass. It's seen worse than a wet phone.

a2fa2900a4e6.speaker: ray
a2fa2900a4e6.text: "Ringing twice will not make it faster." I believe him.

093035c61cae.speaker: ray
093035c61cae.text: Not with Danny's phone still in my pocket.

d212692717a7.speaker: ray
d212692717a7.text: I put the phone in the tray. Ike pulls it through and turns it over under his lamp.

946ffaaa4f0f.speaker: ray
946ffaaa4f0f.text: Me. Only me. Nobody else hears about this phone, Ike. Not the day shift. Not anybody.

e0d5f67dee9c.speaker: ray
e0d5f67dee9c.text: Danny Reyes's phone. Two nights in the river, and the first thing it found was somebody who'd stay up for it.

2c8331fd624a.speaker: ray
2c8331fd624a.text: I've got a loan shark and a doorman.

d77f15aa32db.speaker: preacher
d77f15aa32db.text: You didn't have to do that.
d77f15aa32db.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

6cf11e3f94e3.speaker: preacher
6cf11e3f94e3.text: Then it's a good job, tonight.
6cf11e3f94e3.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

c4ddb2bf75c3.speaker: preacher
c4ddb2bf75c3.text: The reeds, under the drain. Everything comes to the reeds. Shopping carts. Shoes. A wedding dress, once. I didn't ask.
c4ddb2bf75c3.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

d8a766fe3a4d.speaker: preacher
d8a766fe3a4d.text: The uniform said sorry, after. Nobody's said sorry to me since 1991.
d8a766fe3a4d.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

c6dd1b1ea69e.speaker: preacher
c6dd1b1ea69e.text: I'll be all right. Go find who did that boy.
c6dd1b1ea69e.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

c57e9da2d32b.speaker: preacher
c57e9da2d32b.text: "The Lord is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart." Psalm thirty-four. Go on.
c57e9da2d32b.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

53c66ed05777.speaker: preacher
53c66ed05777.text: I told you what I saw. I'll tell it again in a courtroom if somebody asks me.
53c66ed05777.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

20f376b9f1aa.speaker: preacher
20f376b9f1aa.text: Not up close. But I seen it fly. Tuesday night, past three. Bars closed, freeway quiet.
20f376b9f1aa.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

78bf972c6535.speaker: preacher
78bf972c6535.text: A long gray car stops in the middle of the bridge. A big man gets out. Old cop's coat, the kind with the belt.
78bf972c6535.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

1623d99d3ca6.speaker: preacher
1623d99d3ca6.text: Stands at the rail like he's praying. Then he throws something. Small. Black. Into the reeds, under the drain.
1623d99d3ca6.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

292fcc87ea50.speaker: preacher
292fcc87ea50.text: Didn't need to. I've seen a thousand like him. He stood like a cop. Cops stand like the ground owes them money.
292fcc87ea50.voice: kokoro: am_eric, -3 semitones, speed 0.82, warmth 4, flutter 0.08

0f0451ac98b1.speaker: ray
0f0451ac98b1.text: The Los Angeles River. Fifty-one miles of concrete and three inches of water, doing an impression of a river.

de5a84e5eaa9.speaker: ray
de5a84e5eaa9.text: Make it two more and I'll buy.

848a1bdb5ae1.speaker: ray
848a1bdb5ae1.text: Owen Tate. Twenty-four. His Chomp jacket says SPEED IS SERVICE in letters bigger than his name.

34a005da3d41.speaker: ray
34a005da3d41.text: Dr. Shah, kneeling on wet concrete at four in the morning. Third time tonight.

226f3a7a87af.speaker: ray
226f3a7a87af.text: A heavy secondhand e-bike. The back end's crushed: rack bent, rear light smashed, yellow box caved in.

114b6e7a7aff.speaker: ray
114b6e7a7aff.text: Owen's phone, still in the mount.

32081f37967b.speaker: ray
32081f37967b.text: Preacher carried this bike down a flight of stairs and never touched a nine-hundred-dollar phone.

129e3798cd97.speaker: ray
129e3798cd97.text: A tarp tent pitched square as a barracks. Boots lined up, a folded flag, a Bible on a milk crate.

7799ed8068ea.speaker: ray
7799ed8068ea.text: It's his house. I'll knock with my eyes.

60f25f43a14b.speaker: ray
60f25f43a14b.text: Preacher, at his tent, reading to the river.

a34d3e0f7485.speaker: ray
a34d3e0f7485.text: Two long lines in the green slime, side by side, from the fence gap at the top down to where Owen lies.

b1f3ac71619f.speaker: ray
b1f3ac71619f.text: Heels. Somebody dragged him to the edge and let the slope do the rest.

653423bd6fa7.speaker: ray
653423bd6fa7.text: Too steep and too slick. Owen didn't walk down it either.

ee7ebac7792d.speaker: ray
ee7ebac7792d.text: Down the middle of every step, a single muddy tire line, and big boot prints beside it. That's how the bike came down.

e91bdda1581e.speaker: ray
e91bdda1581e.text: A reed island under the bridge, black as a closet. My flashlight makes it look worse.

d63373365336.speaker: ray
d63373365336.text: I'm not wading into the LA River blind. Not at my age.

4881e3f43ccb.speaker: ray
4881e3f43ccb.text: Doss's spotlight lays a white oval across the reeds. Something glints in the roots.

ff9e3039db7f.speaker: ray
ff9e3039db7f.text: Water, mud, a shopping cart. Nothing else of anybody's.

9c4abeef0d28.speaker: ray
9c4abeef0d28.text: A drain pipe sticks out of the pier, dribbling into the reeds. That's where the bridge's gutters come out.

e4530346d30a.speaker: ray
e4530346d30a.text: Everything that went down that grate came out right here.

95062a86e10e.speaker: ray
95062a86e10e.text: I'm not climbing into a drain. I've done enough tonight that I'll have to explain.

e134b27fa8af.speaker: ray
e134b27fa8af.text: Three inches deep and in no hurry.

96229999a8d2.speaker: ray
96229999a8d2.text: It's colder than it looks. Most things are, down here.

68a17fa2d54c.speaker: ray
68a17fa2d54c.text: Somebody planted willows in the river to make it look like a river. The willows haven't been told.

2690f331f1c5.speaker: ray
2690f331f1c5.text: Doss's spotlight. Brightest thing on the river tonight.

8e3ad2351e8d.speaker: ray
8e3ad2351e8d.text: Hit from behind. The rack's bent flat and the box is caved in like somebody stepped on a lunchbox.

edb1c4ee66ba.speaker: ray
edb1c4ee66ba.text: Blue-gray paint flakes in the bent metal. Somebody's car left a little of itself here.

62f2e38bc46a.speaker: ray
62f2e38bc46a.text: And wedged in a crack in the box, a sliver of clear plastic with a curved edge.

aa98aedcd20c.speaker: ray
aa98aedcd20c.text: Under the crushed lid, a stack of receipts and a used textbook. Anatomy and Physiology, a community college sticker on the spine.

311adfc6d03e.speaker: ray
311adfc6d03e.text: He rode nights so he could study days.

b51b7334ac31.speaker: ray
b51b7334ac31.text: Receipts, a textbook, and a bent rack. That's all Owen had back there.

96ab045507b2.speaker: ray
96ab045507b2.text: Glendower at one-fifty. A one-star review. Two-oh-four, the trip paused. And his mother.

bb400da86167.speaker: ray
bb400da86167.text: It's locked, but the notifications show.

6e71a23b4525.speaker: ray
6e71a23b4525.text: Glendower Avenue, up in the hills over Los Feliz. That's where his night ended.

7558443a0cee.speaker: ray
7558443a0cee.text: One star. "Threatened that someone would get killed."

19c384eecda5.speaker: ray
19c384eecda5.text: Two-oh-four, he stopped moving on Fletcher Drive.

93b06aa5f16a.speaker: ray
93b06aa5f16a.text: The bike came down the stairs with Preacher. Owen came down the bank with somebody else.

9f91c51351df.speaker: ray
9f91c51351df.text: I did, actually. That's the job.

c9c638d4f4cf.speaker: ray
c9c638d4f4cf.text: Big fellow, old raincoat, cop's shoes.

066fc440d0de.speaker: ray
066fc440d0de.text: A cop who'd stopped being one.

323f808d864a.speaker: ray
323f808d864a.text: I step off the concrete into the water. It's colder than it looks.

54f8d633cdd1.speaker: ray
54f8d633cdd1.text: There. Half a headlight, jammed in the roots. Clear plastic, curved, chrome on the back.

3f530c079fbe.speaker: ray
3f530c079fbe.text: Something else catches the light, a few feet deeper in, pressed into the mud. A phone in a cracked black case.

13079c7700ea.speaker: ray
13079c7700ea.text: Somebody else lost something down here.

bd3590a23cec.speaker: ray
bd3590a23cec.text: River water runs out of the case. On the back, a Blue Note sticker, half peeled. Under it, white tape, in marker:

a9e6d26b3eee.speaker: ray
a9e6d26b3eee.text: "D.R. If found call the Blue Note."

59ae70e2a1d6.speaker: ray
59ae70e2a1d6.text: Danny Reyes's phone. Two nights in the river. Somebody wanted it to go out to sea.

f6015216aa6a.speaker: ray
f6015216aa6a.text: This river hasn't taken anything anywhere since they poured the concrete.

937276f211e0.speaker: shah
937276f211e0.text: Third time tonight, Ray. One more and I get a free coffee.

068ee10dad6a.speaker: shah
068ee10dad6a.text: Same plastic I took out of his hair. Bag it.

7f589fd92341.speaker: shah
7f589fd92341.text: That's been in the water a lot longer than he has.

900c265a10c2.speaker: shah
900c265a10c2.text: A car. Both lower legs broken at the same height, nineteen inches up, from behind. That's a bumper.

26236e3fac2e.speaker: shah
26236e3fac2e.text: Then he went up onto the hood, the back of his head hit the edge of it, and he came down on the road. It was fast, Ray. He didn't feel the river.

424f6a96202d.speaker: shah
424f6a96202d.text: Somebody should tell Officer Doss that a beating doesn't break both shins at bumper height.

bff234561e35.speaker: shah
bff234561e35.text: Between a quarter to two and half past. Rain and cold concrete, so don't hold me to the minute.

5c5d5fa52928.speaker: shah
5c5d5fa52928.text: His back and arms are scraped raw. That's the slope. And they barely bled.

ed3e7263862e.speaker: shah
ed3e7263862e.text: Meaning his heart had already stopped when he went down the bank. He didn't fall down here, Ray. Somebody slid him.

9dfaa6a31da6.speaker: shah
9dfaa6a31da6.text: Glass in his hair. Not windshield; that crumbles into little cubes. This is hard, clear plastic, with an edge. Headlight.

ebdec609f1b0.speaker: shah
ebdec609f1b0.text: From the car's face. Somebody's driving around tonight with one eye.

dcf4ce0a95e5.speaker: shah
dcf4ce0a95e5.text: He's got a card in his wallet with his mother's number on it. It says "In case."

1c15968ce813.speaker: shah
1c15968ce813.text: Somebody's going to have to use it.

54f960c0f7cd.speaker: ray
54f960c0f7cd.text: Put your spotlight on the reeds.

7cbe4eb45819.speaker: ray
7cbe4eb45819.text: Why carry the bike all the way down?

5c87dfe5c95b.speaker: ray
5c87dfe5c95b.text: Where does stuff end up, off that bridge?

aeaba6e8c4a5.speaker: ray
aeaba6e8c4a5.text: There's a camera on Mr. Pryce's gate.

e4c9469469bb.speaker: ray
e4c9469469bb.text: He says he never stopped. His shoes say he went for a walk by the river.

739500729f42.speaker: ray
739500729f42.text: A coyote. I've got half a headlight that says different.

91dc57e440ba.speaker: ray
91dc57e440ba.text: He says a car service. Somebody up on Glendower wrote down otherwise.

ad77fd9b7028.speaker: ray
ad77fd9b7028.text: Shah says a car. Doss says a tent. Only one of them went to medical school.

ecffb43150cf.speaker: ray
ecffb43150cf.text: Everything that went down that drain is in the reeds. Doss has a spotlight he's very proud of.

4cea5dcf2fe3.speaker: ray
4cea5dcf2fe3.text: She thinks he threatened her. Somebody should tell her what he was worried about.

c0c0efb0d891.speaker: ray
c0c0efb0d891.text: I've got a plate. Otis can run it faster than I can spell it.

a2eefbbbd27b.speaker: ray
a2eefbbbd27b.text: Shah's sure it was a car. Preacher's still sitting in one. One of those things has to change.

a3c7d7495a0c.speaker: ray
a3c7d7495a0c.text: A sliver of a headlight. Where's the rest of its face?

9f4db35d7c32.speaker: ray
9f4db35d7c32.text: Glendower can wait two minutes. Those reeds can't tell me anything in the dark.

c4aadb362a57.speaker: ray
c4aadb362a57.text: Room 214. Kenji, Gus, and now Owen in the corners. Danny's still in the middle, waiting for somebody to notice him.

66c312d60ad5.speaker: ray
66c312d60ad5.text: Not yet. Owen's waiting on the board.

4fb44b2197c2.speaker: ray
4fb44b2197c2.text: Ten to five. The sky over the parking lot is thinking about getting lighter.

3841a9fc5447.speaker: ray
3841a9fc5447.text: Four corners and a middle. Kenji, Gus, Owen, and Danny, still waiting.

caec73e9c616.speaker: ray
caec73e9c616.text: Owen's closed. Danny's got his phone back, sort of.

2021329c09c4.speaker: ray
2021329c09c4.text: Twenty-four, a yellow box and a red light. Who didn't stop?

8fae4e5a8321.speaker: ray
8fae4e5a8321.text: Preacher carried the bike down to save it. Shah says a car, and Preacher hasn't driven anything since 1991.

dad847f4e4f5.speaker: ray
dad847f4e4f5.text: Courtney sent him out into the rain. Her own camera says she never left the house.

a98fdf1e8e01.speaker: ray
a98fdf1e8e01.text: Courtney gave him one star. That's cruelty, not a car. And I never checked where she was.

999de5734573.speaker: ray
999de5734573.text: Haskell left at eleven with his wife and a driver. Men like Haskell don't drive themselves anywhere.

d4052726c52e.speaker: ray
d4052726c52e.text: The man he told not to drive.

116fca293e3f.speaker: ray
116fca293e3f.text: Think, Ray. What on his car came from the river, and who saw him take the keys?

2a1d571ca850.speaker: ray
2a1d571ca850.text: Elliot Crane. He ran down the one man who told him not to drive, then tried to give him to the river.

396c0d34a92e.speaker: ray
396c0d34a92e.text: Three pieces of paper that haven't been introduced.

14e1a39117b0.speaker: ray
14e1a39117b0.text: Then it's a big night for both of you.

a05f8cff16d4.speaker: ray
a05f8cff16d4.text: The headlight fits like a key. A valet ticket, a gate camera, river mud on his shoes.

fc1fa9246f48.speaker: ray
fc1fa9246f48.text: Nothing you can hand the captain.

af56902ddc7a.speaker: ray
af56902ddc7a.text: I didn't tell her about the phone. I couldn't have told you why. Twenty-six years, and some nights the job keeps its mouth shut for you.

e0ddefd0fb99.speaker: ray
e0ddefd0fb99.text: I talked to him tonight. Through the door.

569e7e7a1def.speaker: ray
569e7e7a1def.text: Sal had a bar to open at four this afternoon. He wasn't the kind to leave the glasses dirty.

46c7a40581b0.speaker: doyle
46c7a40581b0.text: Ray. A councilman's chief of staff. At four in the morning.

d0dea2c863aa.speaker: doyle
d0dea2c863aa.text: Ted Haskell called the captain at home. The captain called me at home. Do you know how often the captain calls me at home?

99f40d855013.speaker: doyle
99f40d855013.text: Then book him. By the book, every comma. I don't want to read about one shortcut.

58585029ce38.speaker: doyle
58585029ce38.text: Then I'll hand him nothing at eight. Go home at six, Ray. *click*

e61a6c05b7c8.speaker: otis
e61a6c05b7c8.text: It's the Blue Note. The porter came in to mop at half past four. Sal Moretti. He's hanging in the back room.

17e2859cd45c.speaker: otis
17e2859cd45c.text: Uniforms are calling it a suicide.

1b1b134ac016.speaker: ray
1b1b134ac016.text: That's his car. Now put him in it.

db04662f83e1.speaker: ray
db04662f83e1.text: That's who drove. First, what his car did.

e0d50d86f6f1.speaker: ray
e0d50d86f6f1.text: Blue-gray. Half the hills are blue-gray.

f8a62a770cab.speaker: ray
f8a62a770cab.text: A headlight broke. I need the face it broke off.

07551a3ff05f.speaker: ray
07551a3ff05f.text: That's what killed him. I need which car.

c7b48e570702.speaker: ray
c7b48e570702.text: He took the keys. I want him on the road.

620c83c51089.speaker: ray
620c83c51089.text: That's what he did after. I need who was behind the wheel.

a6e6a88c5791.speaker: ray
a6e6a88c5791.text: Somebody slid him. Pin who was driving.

72c38fb758d3.speaker: ray
72c38fb758d3.text: That's how Owen got down the bank. Pin how he got hit.

c015ed408c60.speaker: ray
c015ed408c60.text: That's when and where. The board wants who.

faa47b4ebe6e.speaker: ray
faa47b4ebe6e.text: That's what Owen saw coming. Pin what came.

bdb5c6e3d192.speaker: ray
bdb5c6e3d192.text: That clears Preacher. I'm here to catch somebody.

524647d469af.speaker: ray
524647d469af.text: That's a man hiding something. I'm pinning the thing.

834c033fb150.speaker: ray
834c033fb150.text: That's who paid for the party. Not who drove home from it.

99fa9d8ffba6.speaker: ray
99fa9d8ffba6.text: Half a headlight. Clear plastic, curved, chrome on the back.

987ce74c6208.speaker: ray
987ce74c6208.text: Moulded into the plastic: four interlocking rings and a part number starting 4K0. A smear of blue-gray paint on the broken edge.

513378cbefb8.speaker: ray
513378cbefb8.text: Number forty-seven. Crane. Out one fifty-five. "Guest insisted. Offered rideshare, declined."

2b33ff31dd1f.speaker: ray
2b33ff31dd1f.text: Harlan Pryce and Pryce Development request the pleasure of your company. An evening with Councilmember Ted Haskell.

259e50e3cb15.speaker: ray
259e50e3cb15.text: It unfolds. A glass tower on Hollywood Boulevard, across from the Chinese Theatre.

6ec128ab4954.speaker: ray
6ec128ab4954.text: They've drawn a lobby where the Blue Note is.

faafbc25568a.speaker: ray
faafbc25568a.text: Same rezoning that's emptying Gus's block.

d7d791902611.speaker: ray
d7d791902611.text: Same name as the notice outside the Blue Note.

7fca8c28f703.speaker: ray
7fca8c28f703.text: Item one. Cell phone, black case, Blue Note sticker. Received by I. Feld.

aa679054a668.speaker: ray
aa679054a668.text: A sliver of clear plastic with a curved edge, from the crushed box on Owen's bike.

07ef2212ed32.speaker: ray
07ef2212ed32.text: A phone in a cracked black case, river water still in it. A half-peeled Blue Note sticker, and white tape: "D.R. IF FOUND CALL THE BLUE NOTE."
